text:
64세 남성, acute respiratory failure로 입원. Severe community-acquired pneumonia 확인됨.

BP 92/58 mmHg. HR 118 bpm. RR 28 breaths/min. BT 38.5°C. SpO2 86% (room air).

Severe cough 호소함.

Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q12h 투여 중.

Oxygen support: High-flow nasal cannula 적용함.

Ventilator 사용 중.

Negative fluid balance 확인됨.

Clinical status: drowsy.
